market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio is not a front-runner for the 2028 GOP nomination; the field is likely to include higher-profile rivals like Ron DeSantis and potentially new entrants. A 13.9% chance assigns him roughly a 1-in-7 shot, which overstates his probability given his 2016 loss, lack of executive office, and uncertainty about him running. Other prediction markets and commentary typically peg Rubio in the 5–10% range, making the NO side undervalued.
evidence_points: Rubio failed to secure the nomination in 2016 and hasn’t held national office since his Senate seat.
Potential 2028 GOP candidates include governors with stronger electoral profiles (DeSantis, Youngkin, Haley) and a sitting VP (if Republican).
Other betting platforms (e.g., PredictIt, Polymarket) have Rubio’s 2028 odds well below 14%, often around 5–7%.
sources_consulted: Historical primary polling and betting data
